title: Image thumbnails corrupted
summary: thumbnail outputs became invalid after a storage client upgrade

deployments: storage SDK v8 enabled multipart uploads without awaiting final stream flush

runbooks.title: Partial object writes
runbooks.content: Corrupt objects without storage errors require validating byte counts, flush completion, and atomic publication.

oracle.root_cause: The v8 storage client completed multipart uploads before the thumbnail stream flushed.
